findings.finding: V1 assigns each TEST stream a prediction label inherited from one of only six failure families, but proposes a 12-stream permutation test. The label is a family-level object, so unrestricted stream-level permutation is not the correct randomization unit for a family-level heterogeneity claim.
findings.consequence: Inference can be anti-conservative if within-family effects are correlated. The independent prediction-label universe is six families, not twelve stream labels.

findings.finding: With six family-level units, if CAL yields 2 positive versus 4 nonpositive families (or 4 versus 2), the smallest possible exact label-permutation p-value is 1/C(6,2)=1/15=0.0667. Only a 3-versus-3 split can attain 0.05, and then only under perfect separation.
findings.consequence: The V1 CAL support rule can authorize TEST even when its own primary GO criterion is mathematically unreachable.

findings.finding: Planning-only variance from the closed sample gives pooled within-stream replicate SD about 0.1633. Averaging only two replicates implies a replicate-noise SD about 0.1155 for a stream effect, versus about 0.0816 with four replicates.
findings.consequence: Two replicates are a weak basis for freezing family sign/rank predictions. This does not use old family signs or ranks; it is variance-only planning.

findings.finding: The proposed availability-only baseline does not consume CAL effect information while the CAL diagnostic-value predictor does. A stronger baseline should be frozen using the same CAL tranche to orient or fit an availability-only predictor before TEST.
findings.consequence: Without this repair, a positive result could partly reflect unequal calibration information rather than diagnostic-value structure.

required_repairs: Increase the number of independently predicted pre-outcome regime cells beyond six families.
Make the TEST randomization/permutation unit exactly match the frozen prediction unit.
Use a pre-outcome regime definition that does not depend on the exposed DeepSeek family outcomes.
Strengthen the availability-only comparator using the same CAL tranche while keeping its feature set restricted to availability variables.
Freeze replicate count from variance/power planning before any new scientific outcome.
recommended_repair: Use the already-defined orthogonal L9 generator structure to define 18 prediction cells = six failure families x three procedure-depth levels. Keep distractor and schema-ambiguity balanced within cells. Generate fully disjoint CAL and TEST streams for all 18 cells plus a new common heldout panel. Primary prediction inference must operate on the 18 frozen TEST cell effects, not on duplicated family labels.
